# Is your “eco-friendly” copy now illegal in the EU?

> Free greenwashing scanner for product pages, ads and packaging text under the EU Empowering Consumers Directive (2024/825), in force since 27 September 2026: flags carbon-neutral claims, vague words like eco-friendly, home-made badges, future net-zero promises and legal-minimum claims, with the fix for each.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
